notes.title: The game is now suspended
notes.notes:
Greetings dear players,

By this announcement, we would like to talk about[b] The Frontier Outskirts[/b], about it's history and current state. As you already noticed, the game has pretty awful reviews and it's not playable as we knew from the second update. Why is that? Well, let us tell you a story.

[b]The Frontier Outskirts[/b] was the first game developed by the cancelled studio called [b]Matt's Creations[/b]. The team was full of freelancers and guys who didn't have any experiences and just started developing such a game. Later on as the studio was cancelled, half of the team migrated to the new studio with bigger and more experienced team called [b]Struct9 [/b](as you already know) and we took a responsibility for the game. We admit that the game-project was a [b]BIG MESS[/b]. We were trying our best and were working really hard to make your experience as best as possible. But well... As the time went by, it got worse. Many of us in our team gave up on the project and nobody had a taste to continue in the development. It was just so broken and we had many new and much more interesting projects in development such as [b]The God[/b].

So in the recent months we were thinking about hidding the game or just shutting it down from the store as it doesn't meet our standards, it's simply unplayable and we will get worse reviews just because the previous team left us the project in the unusable state. We are very aware that there were some issues, misunderstanding with the community, bans and so on.

By this annoucement, we would like to inform our players, who bought The Frontier Outkskirts that they are still able to play the game, but it will be no longer visible on the Steam Store and we will be no longer take a responsiblity about it's development. We know that there is no excuse and we might have failed you, but we had a really bad conflicts in our team & we were trying our best to fulfil your requirements. We will continue in game development with unique gameplay & game mechanics and we hope, we didn't lose your trust.

The Frontier Outskirts was great idea, but really, really bad execution with bad developers. We promise that this will not happen again as the Struct9 is a new team with new vision & ideas. We will do our best to make unique games & applications and make our community proud.

Now you can look forward to the new upcoming update [b]The God[/b] which is coming up next month and the first playable version [b]The Fallen Kings[/b] which is coming up this December! Also, you can learn more about our recent activity and events on our official web page [url=https://struct9.com]https://struct9.com[/url]

Thank you all for understanding and we hope you will stay with us. If you have any questions, do not hesitate and write them down below.
Best Regards,
[b]Struct9 Team[/b]

notes.title: We are out of Early Access! Thank you!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for great support! Now we are officially out of Early Access so the game is now available in full, completed and stable version. We are very glad that we completed the game successfully. We couldn't finish the game without YOU! Thanks again!

What was fixed and what was added?

Added
• Post effects
• Color correction
• Full multiplayer
• Completed campaign
• In-game voices & sounds
• Tutorial improvements
• Final game stats

Fixed
• AI [AI was freezing and stucking into ground]
• Locomotion movement [more smooth]
• In-game battle atmosphere [not too much chaos]
• Player progression
• Introduction
• Multiplayer server browser
• Sync problems

Please if you find some bugs or issues, write them here to the pinned thread
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/590250/discussions/0/2561864094360246691]TFO - Bug Reports & Questions pinned thread[/url]
We are aware of our mistakes and bugs, so we would like to fix every detail that we didn't notice. Thank you!

The fifth release contains:
- Fixed FPS drops
- Fixed Beamsword lacks
- Fixed AI glitches
- Added new soundtracks

notes.title: TFO Alpha Second Release official date
notes.notes:
[b]The Frontier Outskirts VR[/b] is going very well and we've got great news for you. TFO Alpha First Release is currently online and we are very glad that you keep following the latest news of TFO. The game is going to be very interesting now, because next release will bring a lot of amazing features like VR character, space battles and more.

Thank you very much for the reviews and suggestions. We appreciate every comment and feedback. Only community pushes us forward!

[u]Official release date of TFO Alpha Second Release is [b][i]1st August 2017.[/i][/b][/u]

[b]Upcoming new features:[/b]
[list]
[*] VR Character
[*] Space Battles
[*] New Movement Modes
[*] Improved Troops AI
[*] New Map
[*] Updated Game Style
[/list]

• VR Character
You will be finally able to see your whole virtual body. The first type of character will take you to the incredible battle atmosphere.

• Space Battles
The big next feature of the game are space battles. We are very happy to introduce you this great feature. The upcoming version will include first space map called Star Primes and first collection of spaceships with interiors.

• New Movement Modes
New movement modes is very helpful feature, because a lot of people don't like locomotion movement. So we added many more movement modes. Upcoming version will include 3 new movement modes with a lot of settings. Locomotion [i](you will be able to set up all settings for loco mode)[/i], Teleportation [i](Teleportation speed and many more settings will be available)[/i] and Touchpad movement [i](you will be able to set up settings as you wish as well)[/i]. We really care of your comfort in the game...

• Improved AI
Soldiers will be able to find their own covers much quicker than before. Accuracy and movement flexibility will be also improved.

• New Map
New map for Ground Mode will be something new for TFO. It's a map of Jungle type. It's called The Forest Occupation. More you will see in the game or on the screenshots.

• Updated Game Style
As the game moves forward, we really want to update game style as much as it's possible. It's more futuristic!

Thank you very much for reading latest news and we hope you will stay with us! Enjoy and thanks again!!!

Here is some demo shots from upcoming version (Space battles and The Forrest Occupation map for Ground Mode)

notes.title: TFO in Early Access
notes.notes:
First of all, we would like to [b]apologize for our big mistake[/b] that the game was not listed as an Early Access. There was a few technical problems in transaction and in the game release. We are very glad that you like the actual game and respect the game content just in the Alpha version. 

As you probably know, the game is the [b]Early Access[/b] and we have a few information for you...

We plan plenty of things and features to the future this year like VR character and multiplayer. It could be very big fun to fight against/ with your friends on the virtual battlefield. VR Character is very important for us to see your virtual hands and body. There will also many more maps, weapons, enemies, modes... One of the biggest features are space-battles that will be available soon.

This is the official list we plan to the future

• VR Character
• Multiplayer battles
• At least 5 maps
• At least 3 game modes
• Space battles
• Character customization

Most important thing for us is [b]listen to the community[/b]. We have already noticed some new suggestions from the community and we very appreciate that.

Thank you all for understanding and we hope you will be very satisfied with the future game features.

- TFO Team

notes.title: TFO VR is ready
notes.notes:
Welcome to the official store page of [b]The Frontier Outskirts VR[/b]. Main store page is now officialy online and we are receiving first impressions and reviews. First game release [Alpha] is coming up on [b]11th June 2017[/b].

The first game release contains:
• 2 Maps
• 2 Game modes
• First collection of beam swords and weapons
• Enemies and allies
• Interactive environment
• Locomotion movement system

[i]Please notice that the game will be available on 11th June, we do not provide any pre-order keys.[/i]

[b]What's the plan to the future?[/b]
We plan plenty of things and features to the future this year like [b]VR character[/b] and [b]multiplayer[/b]. It could be very big fun to fight against/ with your friends on the virtual battlefield. VR Character is very important for us to see your virtual hands, body etc. We will also add many more maps, weapons, enemies, modes... One of the biggest features are [b]space-battles[/b] that will be available very soon.

[b]Why TFO VR?[/b]
We are small indie game development studio and we haven't seen any VR game of this type. So we've made one. We are full of passion to develop something, where you can literally choose your equipment, battlefield and experience the true futuristic war atmosphere. Everything is about your choice, your feelings.

If you were interested in this game, please keep following the latest news and leave a comment of what should be improved and what'd you like to see in the future releases. Creators don't create game, community create game.

Thank you so much for your attention and we hope you will have a big fun from the game!

- TFO developers team
